quiet: The first column holds the name, the second the age and the third the city.
Each point has an x, a y and a z value stored in order.
The message carries an id, a seconds field and a nanoseconds field set to zero.
The parts list gives the first name, the last name and the email address.
A color is stored as red, green and blue values in that order.
The span starts at one index and ends at another, with a step of one.
The coordinates give latitude, longitude and altitude for each site.
The box records its top, left and bottom edges in pixels.
